title: Prequential rank-order calibration audit of the active SONAR hybrid engine

hypothesis.null: Conditional on the history available before target t, the five target numbers occupy a uniformly random 5-subset of the engine's 40 deterministic ranks; expected mean rank is exactly 20.5.
hypothesis.alternative: The active engine ranks future drawn numbers toward the top; mean rank of the five target numbers is below 20.5.
hypothesis.primary_estimand: gain_t = 20.5 - mean(rank_t(n) for n in target_draw_t); primary blind estimand is the mean gain over the historical OOS segment.

fixed_engine.reproduction: Execute the exact committed overlapCount, sonarTransitionProfile and sonarAnalogCore functions from src/VinciCasaLab.jsx; no weights or code are changed.

splits.rule: Reuse the active_engine_walkforward chronological 60/20/20 split; no parameter selection or retuning.

exact_null.rank_set: For any pre-target permutation of ranks 1..40, a uniform 5-of-40 draw maps to a uniform 5-subset of ranks.
exact_null.construction: Integer dynamic programming over 5-subsets of ranks 1..40; Monte Carlo draws rank sums from the exact 658008-subset empirical CDF.

inference.conditional_null_test: 100000 Monte Carlo replicates; each replicate samples 641 independent rank-sum outcomes from the exact 5-of-40 rank-sum PMF; lower-tail rank sum is favorable; fixed xorshift32 seed 0x5100A100; add-one p-value.
inference.multiplicity: Conservative Bonferroni adjustment by 43 candidate configurations (42 fixed-rule configurations plus the active app engine) to reflect the pre-existing model-search family. This does not correct unknown analyst degrees of freedom outside that catalog.
inference.effect_interval: 10000 circular block-bootstrap replicates, block length 20, fixed seed 0x5100A101; percentile 95% CI for mean gain.
inference.secondary_outputs: Top5/Top10/Top20 and eight consecutive 5-rank-bin hit means are descriptive only; no secondary p-values or tuning.

integrity_checks: Archive dates strictly increasing and unique; each row is a sorted 5-subset of 1..40.
For target index t, engine receives only archive rows with indices < t.
Every forecast contains exactly one rank for each number 1..40.
Reproduced Top5/Top10/Top20 means reconcile to active_engine_walkforward.json within its published rounding.
Future-mutation invariance: changing target and later archive rows cannot change the forecast for selected historical cutoffs.
No target or future outcomes are passed to the engine.
guardrails: This is an exploratory calibration audit of an already researched engine, not a virgin prospective holdout.
No engine parameters are changed and no model is promoted.
Historical blind OOS has been exposed to prior SONAR research.
A small p-value cannot establish future winning probability or justify a ticket.
No merge or production change; human review required.
next_action: If no rank-order lift is demonstrated, stop retrospective tuning of this engine and continue Q60 append-only prospective collection.
